assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of ALGOL 68-R, in ALGOL 68 Implementation and inspected the cited passage (Printed p. 21 (physical PDF p. 37), THE LANGUAGE, item 1). THE LANGUAGE, item 1 on printed page 21 applies prior specification to identifiers, modes and operators. Its mutually recursive X and Y example uses an explicit forward mode specification.

challenge.method: Test a declaration-order reading that would prohibit every reference to a later completed mode. Compare the preceding specification with the completed mutually recursive definitions.
challenge.results: The example demonstrates an earlier specification of X before Y, so the rule and the forward form are consistent. The paper uses specification as the operative term.

limitations: The result is attributed to the Munich paper. It is scoped to 68-R and distinguishes prior specification from completion of a definition.
